prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one original portfolio project cover for UniSpace, a real academic classroom booking and recurring reservation system; illustrative concept art only.
Primary request: an empty university classroom corridor opening onto a quiet study courtyard, repeating rounded arches and tall windows arranged with precise spatial rhythm. Central perspective, centered distant arch and a quiet empty study table visible through one arch; the architecture itself evokes reservable shared academic spaces.
Style/medium: richly detailed hand-engraved ink illustration, fine etched crosshatching and stippling on subtly textured warm ivory paper, antique architectural copperplate print. Match a family of dramatic densely hatched mountain and river engravings: crisp thin contour lines, intricate shadows, printmaking grain, flat restrained ink color fields, no glossy rendering.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 landscape, edge-to-edge artwork with no border. Architectural focal point centered, repeating arches legible at 510px width, modest crop safe, foreground paving leads the eye inward.
Lighting/mood: calm scholarly stillness; light falls through tall windows in long diagonal patches, with one small amber-lit patch in the middle distance.
Color palette: deep navy ink, muted steel blue shadow tones, warm ivory highlights and paper, only a small amber light accent.
Constraints: completely original imaginary academic architecture, no depiction of a named or real campus. No people, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, UI, screenshots, calendars or fake data. No photographic appearance or generic 3D aesthetic. Do not add a title or project name.
interpretation: Conceptual project illustration, not a real campus, personal photo or application screenshot
